definition_en: the quality of being brief; shortness of speech or time
core_image: 一张便条只写三个字，钉在门上；门外的人一读即走
scene: 上司批语从不废话。The report earned praise for its brevity and clarity.
sceneCN: 这里 brevity 是「简洁」（第 1 个义项：言简意赅的品质）；句意是那份报告因简洁清晰而受称赞。

pos.zh: 短暂；短促（指时间或生命）

derivatives.zh: 同根形容词，义为「简短的」
由同根加副词后缀构成，义为「简短地」
由同根加名词后缀构成，义为「每日祈祷书」
由前缀加同根构成，义为「缩写；缩短」

senses.title: Shortness of speech or writing
senses.definition: the quality of expressing much in few words
senses.definitionCN: 以很少的话表达很多内容的质量
senses.why: The root means short; its first workplace is the sentence.
senses.whyCN: 词根义为「短」，它最早的用武之地是句子。

senses.title: Shortness of duration
senses.definition: the fact of lasting only a short time
senses.definitionCN: 仅延续很短时间的事实
senses.example: We mourned the brevity of the spring visit.
senses.exampleCN: 我们惋惜春日来访的短暂。
senses.why: Short applies to time as well as text, and the noun stretches to cover both.
senses.whyCN: 「短」既形容文字也形容时间，名词随之兼管两者。

senses.title: Conciseness as a virtue
senses.definition: brevity praised as a style or discipline
senses.definitionCN: 被视为文风或修养的简洁
senses.example: In this office, brevity is a professional virtue.
senses.exampleCN: 在这间办公室，简洁是一种职业美德。
senses.why: Once speech costs time or money, cutting words becomes a moral good.
senses.whyCN: 一旦说话要花时间或金钱，删词便成了善举。

senses.title: A concise remark or form
senses.definition: an instance of brief speech or a shortened form
senses.definitionCN: 一次简短的发言或缩略的形式
senses.example: His farewell was a brevity of two words.
senses.exampleCN: 他的道别只有短短两个字。
senses.why: The quality can be counted: each short utterance is one brevity.
senses.whyCN: 品质可以计数：每一次简短言谈即是一个 brevity。

senses.title: Shortness of life
senses.definition: the short span of human life, in reflective use
senses.definitionCN: 人生之短促，用于沉思语境
senses.example: Poets dwell on the brevity of our days.
senses.exampleCN: 诗人反复咏叹人生之短促。
senses.why: Life is the longest text we write, and it too is short.
senses.whyCN: 人生是我们写就的最长文本，而它同样短促。

senses.title: Terse manner of a person
senses.definition: a habit of speaking little and pointedly
senses.definitionCN: 说话少而尖刻干脆的习惯
senses.example: Known for her brevity, she answered in single words.
senses.exampleCN: 她以寡言著称，回答只有单词。
senses.why: The style of the text attaches to the speaker who produces it.
senses.whyCN: 文本的风格附着于产出文本的说话人。

senses.title: Economy in art or music
senses.definition: compression and economy in a work of art
senses.definitionCN: 艺术作品中的压缩与经济
senses.example: The song's brevity is its secret weapon.
senses.exampleCN: 这首歌的短小正是它的秘密武器。
senses.why: What holds for sentences holds for sonnets and songs: less can carry more.
senses.whyCN: 句子之道通于诗与歌：少可载多。

senses.title: A brief summary or abstract
senses.definition: in older use, a condensed account of a larger work
senses.definitionCN: 旧义指对长篇著作的缩略记述
senses.example: Monks kept brevities of the monastery chronicle.
senses.exampleCN: 僧侣们为修道院编年史做简编。
senses.why: A text that has been made short is itself called a shortness.
senses.whyCN: 被缩短的文本自身也被称作「短」——brevity 由此指简编。

intro.en: Brevity comes from Latin brevitas, formed on brevis, short, the same root behind brief and abbreviate.
intro.cn: brevity 源自拉丁语 brevitas，建立在 brevis（短的）之上，与 brief、abbreviate 同根。

items.en: The reconstructed root *mregh-u- meant short, giving brevis and Greek brachys alike.
items.cn: 重构词根 *mregh-u- 意为短，同时产出拉丁 brevis 与希腊 brachys。

items.en: Latin brevis meant short, and brevitas meant shortness, in speech and in time.
items.cn: 拉丁语 brevis 意为短，brevitas 意为短促，兼指言与时。

items.en: Old French kept breve as the adjective and breve as a short document.
items.cn: 古法语保留 breve 作形容词，亦作「短简文书」之义。

items.en: English borrowed brevity from Latin brevitas, in Chaucer's generation.
items.cn: 十四世纪，英语自拉丁语 brevitas 借入 brevity，时当乔叟之世。

items.en: The abstract noun settled into praise and blame of style: brevity versus tedium.
items.cn: 此后抽象名词定型于对文风的褒贬：简洁对冗长。

items.en: Modern use favors the speech sense, with the time sense in set phrases like the brevity of life.
items.cn: 现代用法以言辞义为主，时间义存于「人生苦短」类固定语。

note.en: The brev- family is regular; its nearest rivals are the concise family and the terse family.
note.cn: brev- 词族规则；最近的竞争者是 concise 与 terse 两族。

entries.definition: to shorten a word or text
entries.definitionCN: 缩略；前缀 ab- 加同根

entries.definition: the daily prayer book of clergy
a rare old word for an abstract

entries.definitionCN: 庄重；引力；仅词尾模式相同，词根不同

entries.definition: expression giving much information in few words
entries.definitionCN: 简洁；与 brevity 相近但更强调信息密度

entries.definition: careful use of words or means
entries.definitionCN: 经济笔法；宽泛的风格术语

normalIntro.en: Say brief and add -ity: briefness is brevity, the Latin way.
normalIntro.cn: 念 brief 再加 -ity：briefness 的拉丁式说法就是 brevity。

normal.en: brev- is the Latin root for short.
-ity makes abstract nouns, as in clarity.
abbreviate hides the same root inside.
the Greek cousin is brachy-, as in brachytherapy.
normal.cn: 希腊语表亲是 brachy-，如 brachytherapy。

normal.en: brevity of life is the classic collocation.
normal.cn: brevity of life 是经典搭配。

abstract.en: A door note of three words that moves a whole day.
abstract.cn: 三个字的门上便条，挪动了一整天。

abstract.en: Life itself is the briefest text: punctuate well.
abstract.cn: 人生本身就是最短的文本：标点要好。

examples.en: The general's orders were models of brevity.
examples.cn: 将军的命令堪称简洁的典范。

examples.en: For all its brevity, the speech moved the hall to tears.
examples.cn: 言简而意深，演讲令全场落泪。

examples.en: He reflected on the brevity of childhood as his son left for school.
examples.cn: 儿子上学去了，他感叹童年之短。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「不磨叽」——说话「不磨叽」就是简短：brevity 即「不磨叽」的品质。

root: 印欧重构词根 *mregh-u-（短）→ 拉丁语 brevis（短的）→ brevitas（短促）→ 中古英语经法语路径借入 brevity；与 brief、abbreviate 同根，与希腊语 brachys（短）同源。

sensesIntro.en: The noun measures shortness twice: in words and in time, then adds the counted remark, the terse person, and the condensed text.
sensesIntro.cn: 名词两度丈量「短」：词之短与日之短，另加可数的简语、寡言之人及缩略之文。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a three-word note that says everything
core.cn: 核心意象：一张写尽一切的三个字便条

branches.en: words kept short: the style, the utterance, the speaker
branches.cn: 词句之短：文风、话语与说话人

branches.en: shortness as craft: praised discipline, artistic economy
branches.cn: 作为技艺之短：受赞的克制、艺术的省笔

branches.en: time kept short: visits, and life itself
branches.cn: 时光之短：来访，以及人生本身

branches.en: the product of shortening: the abstract of a chronicle
branches.cn: 缩短的产物：编年史之简编

branches.en: the shared root of both shortnesses: time measured in words
branches.cn: 两种「短」的共同根源：以词量时

intro.en: A clean Latin formation: brev- plus the abstract suffix -itas, naturalized as -ity.
intro.cn: 典型的拉丁构词：brev- 加抽象后缀 -itas，归化为英语 -ity。

latinIntro.en: Latin supplies the whole family; Greek offers brachys as a parallel root.
latinIntro.cn: 整个词族由拉丁语供给；希腊语另以 brachys 作平行词根。

items.exampleCN: brief 与 brevity 是表亲
